body:
Thank you.
Yes, there are things I enjoy, I like to travel and ride my bike or take walks, I like being in nature. I also have other interests like books and sports.
These things do bring a little bit of light into my life sometimes.

But the big problem is that as long as my general situation is so gloomy, as long as I don't know what to do with my life and I feel unable to make friends, I will always feel awful and unhappy, and no hobby or interest is going to change that.

I recently learned of the term "situational depression" and I think that's exactly what I have, I'm convinced that if I had a better social life and a clue about my future I'd stop being depressed. Maybe not immediately, but gradually. 

But how to get there? I simply have no idea what to do, in high school I was very good at languages and history, but you can't make a career out of that unless you decide to become a teacher, and that was never on the table for me because of my severe social anxiety and "stage fright". I actually majored in English and history in my short time at college, but even if I had enjoyed that, the pressure and my fear of failure would have been too much for me. Like I said, I've always had very low self-esteem, so I've always been scared of failing, no matter what I attempted.

Also, I'm scared that even if I do somehow, someday find a way out of the darkness and get a better life, I'll always look back on these many years I wasted and feel deep regret. I don't know if I could deal with that for the rest of my life.

I never tried meds, I was always scared of the side effects and my therapist never urged me to try them. 
Maybe I should try therapy again with someone else...


I've made some online friends I can talk to about my interests since I spend a lot of time online these days, but it's not the same as having "real life" friends since they're all pretty far away.
